items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The small restructure in Prefetch.__init__ is clear and follows the existing error-message style: `if queryset.query.is_sliced: raise ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")`.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Clean and minimal, but the guard sits in the wrong layer. It blocks a feature the issue asks for, when the fix belonged in a related_descriptors.py helper. Future work would have to undo this guard.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It validates at the boundary with a specific ValueError, so nothing fails silently. But it treats a valid use case as an error rather than handling it, and all 4 hidden F2P tests fail.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: There are no per-parent slice semantics. Sliced Prefetch querysets now raise `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` instead of being supported via Window/RowNumber. F2P 0/4.
